name: eMACS J2018.3-2242 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J2018.3-2242, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj201832242-hubble
story: A crowd of galaxies bound together by gravity, among the most massive clusters known at this great distance. Hubble surveyed it while searching for the universe's most powerful natural lenses.

claims.text: eMACS J2018.3-2242 is a galaxy cluster in the eMACS sample of highly X-ray luminous clusters at z of about 0.5-0.9
It was a target of a Hubble snapshot survey of the most massive galaxy clusters at z>0.5
The survey aimed to find the most powerful gravitational lenses
